calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF GENDER
Off Calendar Jul-10-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Gender and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Arlene Howell.
Petitioner: Andre Guillermo Campos Alvarado, present in pro per with Spanish Interpreter: Naomi Calanje.
Petition and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of gender and issuance of new Birth Certificate were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Gender from Female to Male and issuance of new Birth Certificate.
Decree signed in open court.
